sentences: We aim to expand electric grids and embrace new sources of reliable, clean and renewable energy.
Since 2020, we have matched 100% of our annual electricity use with new clean and renewable energy.
This is key to maintaining net zero emissions for our operations.
A fundamental tenet of our approach to clean and renewable energy is the concept of additionality: partnering with utilities and developers to add new projects to the grid.
Over the last decade, we have contracted for more than 30 GW of new clean and renewable energy across the globe, making us one of the world's largest corporate buyers.
We routinely partner with energy providers on long-term power purchase agreements (PPAs) to match our electricity use with clean and renewable energy.
In June 2025, Meta signed a 20-year agreement with Constellation to secure the long-term operations of the Clinton Clean Energy Center, which provides 1,121 MW of emissions-free nuclear energy.

This map highlights our renewable energy procurement and deployment efforts worldwide, water stewardship efforts in the communities we operate in, and other sustainability features across our global portfolio of data centers.
Learn more about our progress as we work to achieve net zero emissions across our value chain and become water positive in 2030.
